title: Auto-Remediation: Payment Service Failure Rate Rollback (GitLab)
description: Detects high failure rate on payment-service via Davis and triggers the GitLab bad-release pipeline with ACTION=rollback to reset the failure rate to zero.

input.content:
## Auto-remediation fired 🚀

  Davis detected a problem on **`payment-service`** in cluster
  `__CLUSTER_NAME__` and this workflow has automatically
  triggered the rollback pipeline in GitLab.

  ### Problem details

  | Field | Value |
  |---|---|
  | Problem | **{{ result("extract_event_details").problemTitle }}** |
  | Problem ID | `{{ result("extract_event_details").problemId }}` |
  | Status | `{{ result("extract_event_details").status }}` |
  | Root cause | [Bad release pipeline]({{ result("extract_event_details").deploymentUrl }}) |
  | Affected entities | `{{ result("extract_event_details").affectedEntities }}` |
  | Detected at | `{{ result("extract_event_details").startTime }}` |

  ### Action taken

  The workflow ran the bad-release pipeline with `BAD_RELEASE_SERVICE=payment-service`, `ACTION=rollback`,
  which resets `payment-service`'s injected failure rate to **0**. A new
  deployment rolls out automatically in ~60 seconds and a
  `CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT` event is fired back into Dynatrace.

  - 📈 [Open the problem in Dynatrace]({{ result("extract_event_details").dtUrl }})
  - 🛠 [GitLab pipeline that fired]({{ result("extract_event_details").deploymentUrl }})

  ### What to verify

  1. Failure-rate timeseries on the **Exercise 1** notebook drops back to 0
     within ~2 minutes.
  2. A new `CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT` event for `payment-service` appears in
     `fetch events | filter event.kind == "CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT"`.
  3. Davis closes the problem on its own once the metric recovers.

  _If the failure-rate doesn't drop, the rollback pipeline failed — open
  the GitLab pipeline link above for the job log._
input.subject: 🔧 Auto-remediation triggered — payment-service rollback in progress (P-{{ result("extract_event_details").problemId }})

fetch_event_details.name: fetch_event_details

input.query:
fetch events, from:now()-25h
| filter event.type == "CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT"
| filter environment == "__CLUSTER_NAME__"
| filter dt.entity.service.name == "payment-service"
| filter event.name == "payment-service deploy-bad-release"
| filter isNotNull(deployment.url)
| dedup {deployment.url}, sort:{timestamp desc}
| sort timestamp desc
| fields `lookup.deployment.url` = deployment.url
| limit 1
